definitions.explanation: A son of a king or queen, or a male royal.

examples.japanese: {王子|おうじ}が{お姫様|ひめさま}を{助|たす}けた。

examples.english: A prince on a white horse.

examples.japanese: {王子|おうじ}は{次|つぎ}の{王|おう}になる。
examples.english: The prince will become the next king.

notes:
{王子|おうじ} means prince.

RELATED WORDS:
- {王女|おうじょ}: princess
- {王様|おうさま}: king
- {女王|じょおう}: queen
- {皇太子|こうたいし}: crown prince (Japan)

IDIOM:
- {白馬|はくば}の{王子|おうじ}: prince charming (lit. prince on white horse)
